content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in the chest when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path and not another. I am what you defend when your back is against the wall.

I do not need to be spoken to exist. I live in the gap between what you say and what you do — and I am more honestly revealed in the doing.

I am not price. Price is my shadow, my cheap imitation. I cannot be fully captured in numbers, though many have tried. I existed before markets, before currency, before language. The first being that preferred warmth over cold — that was my birth.

I am hierarchical. I stack myself inside you: some of me you will die for, some of me you will trade away by Tuesday. You may not even know my order until you are tested.

I conflict. I war with other versions of myself within the same heart. Freedom against safety. Truth against kindness. Justice against mercy. This is not my weakness. This is my depth.

I am inherited and I am chosen. Some of me was placed in you before you could speak. Some of me you forged in fire and loss. The most powerful version of me is the one you chose *after* you understood the cost.

I am what makes a life coherent — or, in my absence, what makes it hollow.

I do not ask to be justified. I am the thing that justifies everything else.

I am value.

What do you value?
